packPanel.title: Content packs
packPanel.intro: Adds non-SRD options from your own pack files. Skald keeps only the links.
packPanel.hint: The blog's password download link can't be pasted: download the file, upload it to your own Google Drive, share it as “Anyone with the link”, and paste that link.
packPanel.order: When two packs have the same entry, the one higher in the list supplies it; the built-in SRD always comes first.
packPanel.removeBody: Its entries leave the compendium and the wizard. Characters keep the text they already have.
packPanel.replaceBody: The list has {from}; this link holds {to}. Replace it in the same place, keeping its switch?
packPanel.supplies: Supplies {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
packPanel.builtinDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# repeats} other {# repeat}} the built-in SRD; the built-in version is used
packPanel.missing: Not on this device yet. Download it again.
packPanel.usage: Packs on this device: {used} MB of {limit} MB
packPanel.guestNote: Saved in this browser only. Sign in to keep the list on every device.
packPanel.signIn: Sign in, or create a guest character first, to load a pack.
packPanel.cached: Couldn't refresh the pack; using the copy on this device.
packPanel.mismatch: Built for another Skald data version; some links may not resolve.

error.notJson: The link didn't return a pack file. Is it shared as “Anyone with the link”?
error.wrongSystem: This file isn't a D&D 2024 content pack.
error.unsupportedVersion: This pack needs a newer version of Skald. Reload the page, then try again.
error.shaMismatch: The file is damaged: its checksum doesn't match.
error.signInRequired: Sign in to load a pack.
error.linkInvalid: Paste a Google Drive file link.
error.rateLimited: Too many downloads in the last hour. Try again in about {detail} min.
error.linkNotPublic: The file isn't shared as “Anyone with the link”.
error.storageFailed: Couldn't read or save the pack. Try again.
error.tooManyPacks: This system already has the most packs allowed.
error.duplicatePack: This link now holds a pack that is already in the list.
error.deviceFull: Not enough room on this device: packs use {used} MB of {limit} MB and this one needs {added} MB. Remove a pack first.
